val [id](id.html): [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)?

Unique session identifier within the `(appName, userId)` namespace. May be `null` when passed to [SessionService.createSession](../-session-service/create-session.html) to request that the service generate one. Methods that address an existing session ([SessionService.getSession](../-session-service/get-session.html), [SessionService.deleteSession](../-session-service/delete-session.html), [SessionService.listEvents](../-session-service/list-events.html), [SessionService.flush](../-session-service/flush.html)) require a non-null [id](../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-key/--root--.html).
